hook: AI-guided TB screening in Pune found about three times more confirmed cases per person screened.

readout.label: Rate ratio, confirmed TB yield, AI vs standard

summary: An AI tool that maps neighborhood TB risk sent screening teams to likelier areas, so they found more confirmed lung TB per person screened and cut cost per case by 66%. Total TB detection did not differ from the standard campaign, which also used mobile X-ray. The comparison used different time periods in the same four units, not a concurrent trial, and the confirmed-case counts were small (10 versus 9).
title: Geospatial AI targeting of tuberculosis active case finding in Pune, India: a quasi-experimental evaluation
